description.zh:
项目环境。
- Prod：生产
- Dev：开发
description.en:
The environment of the workspace. Valid values:

- Prod: production environment

- Dev: development environment

description.zh: 工作流ID列表，可根据工作流Id批量查询多个工作流信息。
description.en: The IDs of the workflows. You can query multiple workflows at a time by workflow ID.
The name of the workflow. Fuzzy match is supported.
The account ID of the workflow owner.
The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.
The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

description.zh:
排序字段。支持修改时间、创建时间等字段，格式为"排序字段+排序方式(Desc/Asc)"（Asc可以缺省）。排序字段的枚举值如下：
- ModifyTime (Desc/Asc)
- CreateTime (Desc/Asc)
- Id (Desc/Asc)

默认值：Id Desc
description.en:
The field used for sorting. Fields such as TriggerTime and StartedTime are supported. The value of this parameter is in the Sort field + Sort by (Desc/Asc) format. By default, results are sorted in ascending order. Valid values:

- ModifyTime (Desc/Asc)

- CreateTime (Desc/Asc)

- Id (Desc/Asc)

Default value: Id Desc.

description.zh: 标签列表，多个标签中满足一个即会返回结果。
description.en: List of tags. A result is returned if it matches any one of the specified tags.

description.zh:
触发方式类型。
- Scheduler
- Manual
- TriggerWorkflow
description.en:
The trigger type.

- Scheduler

- Manual

- TriggerWorkflow

descriptions.zh: 需要购买DataWorks基础版及以上版本才能使用。
descriptions.en: You must purchase DataWorks Basic Edition or a higher edition to use this feature.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public list-workflows --project-id 100 --env-type Prod --ids 1234 --name Workflow1 --owner 1000 --trigger-type Scheduler --sort-by Id_Desc --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --tags key:value --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public ListWorkflows --region cn-hangzhou --TriggerType Scheduler --Owner 1000 --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --SortBy Id_Desc --ProjectId 100 --Ids '[1234]' --EnvType Prod --Tags '["key:value"]' --Name Workflow1
